reply_text:
I've saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM to confirm. The mail is only a draft; it won't go out until someone sends it.

- **Draft:** addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives $2,101 a seat, says Marcus Lindqvist provided the rate and Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis not to pass it on without Anselm's or June's approval.
- **Approval:** no separate request was needed. Hollis is internal, so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve the mail. Hollis isn't one of the people who can see finance figures by default, but Anselm can approve that himself, and his message did.
- **The rate:** I used $2,101 exactly as Anselm wrote it. I didn't check it against Marcus's original message, because that's in channels Anselm isn't in.
